steps.note: Start screen: the player spawns on the Village Green (WorldBuilder.buildWorld builds the island, beach lane and 8 base plots; PlayerDataService claims a plot and BaseManager.claimPlotForPlayer puts the player's name on its sign). The HUD from Game.client.luau shows cash top-right, clear of the Roblox menu corner.

Carry: the player grabbed a brainrot on the beach (BrainrotSpawner.spawnBrainrotOnPad rolled it from BrainrotData's cast and odds; grabBrainrotFromBeach and carryBrainrot weld it overhead with carryBrainrotHome handling) and is dashing back to their base, past the spawn pads and fences.

Base income and shop: the carried brainrot is placed with BaseManager.placeBrainrotOnBase / placeModelOnPad, BaseManager.startIncomeTicker pays every second and spawnFloatingEarningsText floats +$N over the base; the bottom-right buttons are the shop — PlayerDataService handles Rebirth and Boots via RemoteEvents, StealService.lockBase raises the shield.

Tsunami and stealing: TsunamiController.startTsunamiWave warns for 10 seconds, then the wave sweeps the island and washes anyone outside a plot away (BrainrotSpawner.dropCarriedBrainrot returns their catch to the beach); with shields down, StealService.stealBrainrotFromBase lets a rival grab a placed brainrot and run it home.
